name: MTC PageShot
description: Capture full webpages in one click, annotate locally, and export as PNG, PDF, PNG parts, or Copy Image.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'

capture-page.description: Capture the current webpage with MTC PageShot
